level1.text: The protons in a proton beam travelling in a vacuum tube have a speed of $3.0 \cdot 10^{5}\,\text{m/s}$. Coils around the tube produce a magnetic field whose magnetic flux density is $0.25\,\text{T}$ and which is perpendicular to the velocity of the protons. The charge of a proton is $1.602 \cdot 10^{-19}\,\text{C}$. How great is the magnetic force on one proton? Give the answer in the form $\ldots \cdot 10^{-14}\,\text{N}$.

In a school electron-beam tube, electrons of mass $9.109 \cdot 10^{-31}\,\text{kg}$ and charge $1.602 \cdot 10^{-19}\,\text{C}$ fly at a speed of $2.0 \cdot 10^{6}\,\text{m/s}$ perpendicular to a magnetic field. The magnetic flux density is $1.5\,\text{mT}$. How large is the radius of the circular path of the electrons? Give the answer in millimetres.

Between the plates of a velocity selector there is an electric field of $4.0 \cdot 10^{4}\,\text{V/m}$ and perpendicular to it a magnetic field whose magnetic flux density is $0.080\,\text{T}$. At what speed do ions pass straight through the selector? Give the answer in kilometres per second.

An alpha particle of charge $3.204 \cdot 10^{-19}\,\text{C}$ is accelerated from rest by a voltage of $1.5\,\text{kV}$. How much kinetic energy does it gain? Give the answer in the form $\ldots \cdot 10^{-16}\,\text{J}$.

A proton flies at a speed of $5.0 \cdot 10^{6}\,\text{m/s}$ in a magnetic field whose magnetic flux density is $0.40\,\text{T}$. The angle between the velocity and the field is $30^\circ$. The charge of a proton is $1.602 \cdot 10^{-19}\,\text{C}$. How great is the magnetic force on the proton? Give the answer in the form $\ldots \cdot 10^{-13}\,\text{N}$.

level2.text: A proton of mass $1.673 \cdot 10^{-27}\,\text{kg}$ and charge $1.602 \cdot 10^{-19}\,\text{C}$ is accelerated from rest by a voltage of $500\,\text{V}$. After that it flies perpendicular to a magnetic field whose magnetic flux density is $0.050\,\text{T}$. How large is the radius of the circular path of the proton? Give the answer in centimetres.

In an experiment a deuteron of mass $3.344 \cdot 10^{-27}\,\text{kg}$ and charge $1.602 \cdot 10^{-19}\,\text{C}$ goes round a circular path of radius $12\,\text{cm}$ in a magnetic field of $0.60\,\text{T}$. How great is the speed of the deuteron? Give the answer in kilometres per second.

The plates of a velocity selector are $2.0\,\text{cm}$ apart, and the voltage between them is $600\,\text{V}$. Between the plates there is also a magnetic field perpendicular to the electric field, with magnetic flux density $0.15\,\text{T}$. At what speed do ions pass straight through the selector? Give the answer in kilometres per second.

The magnetic flux density of the Earth's magnetic field in Finland is about $50\,\mu\text{T}$. The mass of a proton is $1.673 \cdot 10^{-27}\,\text{kg}$ and its charge $1.602 \cdot 10^{-19}\,\text{C}$. At what speed would a proton have to move perpendicular to the Earth's field for the magnetic force on it to be equal to its weight? Give the answer in millimetres per second.

level3.text: In the mass spectrometer of a radiocarbon laboratory, carbon-12 and carbon-14 ions with the same charge are accelerated from rest by the same voltage and directed into the same magnetic field. The ions travel along a semicircle and strike the detector next to the slit. The radius of the path of the carbon-12 ions is $25.0\,\text{cm}$. Use the masses $12.0\,\text{u}$ and $14.0\,\text{u}$. How far apart on the detector are the points of impact of the carbon-12 and carbon-14 ions? Give the answer in centimetres.

In a cyclotron, protons go round on an ever larger path in a magnetic field, because they are accelerated between two D-shaped electrodes on every half revolution. The accelerating voltage must change direction in step with the revolution of the protons. The mass of a proton is $1.673 \cdot 10^{-27}\,\text{kg}$ and its charge $1.602 \cdot 10^{-19}\,\text{C}$. Show that the period of revolution of a proton does not depend on its speed, and calculate the frequency of revolution of the protons when the magnetic flux density is $1.50\,\text{T}$. Give the answer in megahertz.

A proton and an alpha particle are accelerated from rest by the same voltage, and after that they fly perpendicular to the same magnetic field. The mass of the proton is $1.673 \cdot 10^{-27}\,\text{kg}$ and its charge $e$, the mass of the alpha particle $6.645 \cdot 10^{-27}\,\text{kg}$ and its charge $2e$. How many times as large is the radius of the path of the alpha particle as that of the proton?
